comingSoon: Running events, places and payouts as a team is coming soon. For now you can set up the team and its members.
createBody: A team has its own name and @username. You'll be its first Owner and can then invite the others.
idCheckNote: Owners and Finance need the ID check before the team can be paid.
intro: Run an organizer or a place together. Everyone signs in with their own account and has a role that covers only what they need.
inviteBody: They join when they accept. Choose the role that covers only what they need.
lastOwnerHint: You're the only Owner. Make another member an Owner before you leave.
leaveConfirmBody: You'll lose access to the team. An Owner can invite you again.
noTeams: You're not in any team yet.
notMember: You're not a member of this team.
notTexted: We couldn't text this number. Tell them to sign up on Abonten with it to accept.
pausedLong: This team is paused: nobody can act for it until it has an Owner again. Abonten support can help.
phoneHint: If this number has no Abonten account yet, we'll text it a link. They sign up with the number to accept.
removeConfirmBody: Their access to the team ends at once. Their own account isn't affected.
